Nicest resort restaurant I’ve been to in Vietnam
Nov 2024 • Family
Rừng Thông Mơ (a.k.a. Mơ Restautant) is the most phenomenal atmosphere. Situated on the side of a hill in the forest, it is just so relaxing. Its probably the nicest resort restaurant I’ve been to in Vietnam in terms of the atmosphere, and the service matches what you would expect at Four Seasons Nam Hai, Amanoi and similar places. 

We were staying at the Mơ Stay Forest resort and dined at this restaurant 2 of our 3 evenings in Dalat. 

A series of small pavilions in the forest, each pavilion has just 1-2 tables and its own fireplace. So the dining experience is private and quiet. With a cool breeze in the air, very quiet music, and surrounded by magnificent trees, it’s an unbelievably pleasant dining experience.

The service is attentive and outstanding. They were patient and friendly. There seems to be 1 server per 2 tables and the server is always standing at a nearby station and paying attention. We had several special requests which were well handled – including ordering Canh Ga Chien Nuoc Mam, which is not on the menu, but was excellently prepared.

In terms of good quality, they provide great attention to detail for both food and drinks. The Soda Chanh (lemon soda) was much more of a crafted drink than the typical Soda Chanh - it included a lot of crushed lime, aloe vera chunks, a delicious Vietnamese mint leaf called Chocolate Mint and was just delicious so we had to keep reordering it. 

The food is high-quality and we especially enjoyed the salads. My only request would be to add more Vietnamese food and more vegetable dishes given they grow the vegetables right there at their organic farm, which we had visited earlier in the day. 

There is also a large playground for children.

This is good both for families and romantic dinners. 

The total bills were around VND1.5 million, which is great value for money considering this is the same ort better standard as the best restaurants at 5 star resorts in Vietnam.

Jun 2022 • Couples
I ran into some issues when I first arrived. I was refused entry due to the place was overbooked although I had called right before coming. 

Upon knowing the incident, the founder quickly contacted me to ratify the trouble and invited me over for a chat, during which we had really nice sharing of our works. 

I was also taken a tour around the place by him, while he shared different aspects of running a farm to table restaurant operations, and how he was aiming to build a family oriented concept which involves many different services besides the bistro component, such as farming session for kids, or even coworking area. 

Very nice chat and very nice guy. I would be rooting for him and his team to deliver some awesome experiences for his customers.

Wonderful natural setting.
Apr 2022 • Family
A wonderful bistro located in a forest. The surroundings are beautiful and have very much an ecogical and natural feel.
The menu choice is varied. Sadly when we visited all the vegeterian/ vegan options were unavailable. This was questioned and they accommodated by making a vegeterian version of something from the main meat section.

A truly wonderful way to spend a couple of hours in a tranquil setting.
